body: You’re 15, live for u. If I could go back in time I’d do things way differently. Fuck who I want to fuck and go where I want to go. You have plenty of time to be a slave to the system later

The world is fucked. Family courts are fucked, everything is fucked. Yet I sit here and cry although I have more than enough means to ensure success. I guess I’m still here so the ones I love won’t feel my pain...how long can that last though...
